Implement a full ArtAgents architecture/onboarding/source-tree cleanup end to end. Canonical public concepts should be orchestrators, executors, and elements. Treat performers and instruments as aliases/backward-compatible terms for executors in docs, CLI discoverability, and command dispatch. Preserve VibeComfy as an external executor/performer/instrument, not an orchestrator/conductor. Add a first-class user-editable elements/primitives domain for render/custom elements with schema/registry/discovery/CLI/install/sync/fork/inspect/list/update behavior where appropriate. Bundle default elements in this repo initially and install/sync them by default; design the model so external git/package/catalog defaults can be supported later without storing executable code in a DB. Make defaults fork-on-edit into workspace/theme overrides. Scan multiple roots with priority active theme > user workspace overrides > installed packages > bundled/default managed elements. Add dependency installation/update support for newly created/used custom elements, including JS package deps and Python requirements where declared, without silently mutating global environments. Do not enforce internal structure inside external executors: VibeComfy and future executors may have their own internal workflows/nodes/prompts; ArtAgents should require only a manifest/API boundary for exposing elements/metadata. Keep existing performer/executor install behavior intact where backcompat requires it. Add clear onboarding: README's agent instructions should be improved and used, add AGENTS.md or equivalent concise entry point if appropriate, add/implement pipeline.py doctor and setup if feasible, and make it obvious what an agent/user should do first. Default orchestrators/conductors and default executors/performers/instruments should appear by default and be clearly documented. VibeComfy and future tools should appear by default; include VibeComfy-associated nodes/workflows/prompts from structured metadata/skill docs where feasible, but avoid brittle free-text scraping as the only source. Include a real source-tree cleanup: audit scattered top-level ArtAgents modules such as event_talks.py, cut.py, publish_youtube.py, quality_zones.py, reigh_data.py, video_understand.py, visual_understand.py, audio_understand.py, scene_describe.py, quote_scout.py, transcribe.py, render_remotion.py, and related bin launchers; classify each as orchestrator, executor, element support, or shared library; move ArtAgents-owned executors into a logical executor/performer folder structure with per-executor metadata/skill/context where useful; simplify or remove the confusing curated-folder distinction if a per-executor folder model is clearer; keep backward-compatible wrappers for existing imports and bin commands; add tests for moved modules and default executor/orchestrator discovery. Add focused tests and run relevant tests. Respect existing dirty working-tree changes in artagents/performers/curated/moirae/SKILL.md and artagents/performers/curated/vibecomfy/SKILL.md; do not revert unrelated user edits.

Implement a full ArtAgents architecture/onboarding/source-tree cleanup end to end. Canonical public concepts should be orchestrators, executors, and elements. Preserve VibeComfy as an external executor/performer/instrument, not an orchestrator/conductor. Add a first-class user-editable elements/primitives domain for render/custom elements with schema/registry/discovery/CLI/install/sync/fork/inspect/list/update behavior where appropriate. Bundle default elements in this repo initially and install/sync them by default; design the model so external git/package/catalog defaults can be supported later without storing executable code in a DB.   "patch": "*** Begin Patch\n*** Add File: artagents/setup_cli.py\n+\"\"\"Local setup planner for ArtAgents.\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import argparse\n+import json\n+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass\n+from pathlib import Path\n+\n+from artagents._paths import REPO_ROOT\n+from artagents.elements.cli import _sync_managed_defaults\n+from artagents.elements.install import install_element\n+from artagents.elements.registry import load_default_registry as load_element_registry\n+\n+\n+@dataclass(frozen=True)\n+class SetupStep:\n+    name: str\n+    status: str\n+    detail: str\n+\n+\n+def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:\n+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=\"pipeline.py setup\", description=\"Plan or apply ArtAgents local setup.\")\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--apply\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"Apply local setup mutations. Default is dry-run.\")\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--json\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"Emit machine-readable setup output.\")\n+    return parser\n+\n+\n+def plan_setup(*, apply: bool = False, project_root: str | Path = REPO_ROOT) -> tuple[SetupStep, ...]:\n+    root = Path(project_root)\n+    steps: list[SetupStep] = []\n+    steps.append(\n+        SetupStep(\n+            name=\"mode\",\n+            status=\"apply\" if apply else \"dry-run\",\n+            detail=\"local mutations enabled\" if apply else \"no files or dependencies will be changed\",\n+        )\n+    )\n+    for action in _sync_managed_defaults(dry_run=not apply, overwrite=False, project_root=root):\n+        steps.append(SetupStep(name=\"elements sync\", status=\"applied\" if apply else \"planned\", detail=action))\n+\n+    registry = load_element_registry(project_root=root)\n+    for element in registry.list():\n+        result = install_element(element, project_root=root, dry_run=not apply)\n+        plan = result.plan\n+        if plan.noop_reason:\n+            steps.append(SetupStep(name=\"elements install\", status=\"skipped\", detail=f\"{element.kind}/{element.id}: {plan.noop_reason}\"))\n+            continue\n+        status = \"applied\" if apply else \"planned\"\n+        details = \"; \".join(plan.command_lines())\n+        steps.append(SetupStep(name=\"elements install\", status=status, detail=f\"{element.kind}/{element.id}: {details}\"))\n+    return tuple(steps)\n+\n+\n+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n+    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)\n+    steps = plan_setup(apply=bool(args.apply))\n+    if args.json:\n+        payload = {\n+            \"applied\": bool(args.apply),\n+            \"steps\": [asdict(step) for step in steps],\n+        }\n+        print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True))\n+        return 0\n+\n+    print(\"ArtAgents setup\")\n+    if not args.apply:\n+        print(\"dry-run: pass --apply to sync managed defaults and run local element install commands\")\n+    for step in steps:\n+        print(f\"[{step.status}] {step.name}: {step.detail}\")\n+    return 0\n+\n+\n+if __name__ == \"__main__\":\n+    raise SystemExit(main())\n*** End Patch\n"

Execute the approved plan in the repository.

        /Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/ArtAgents

        Idea:
Implement a full ArtAgents architecture/onboarding/source-tree cleanup end to end. Canonical public concepts should be orchestrators, executors, and elements. Treat conductors as aliases/backward-compatible terms for orchestrators in docs, CLI discoverability, and command dispatch. Treat performers and instruments as aliases/backward-compatible terms for executors in docs, CLI discoverability, and command dispatch. Preserve VibeComfy as an external executor/performer/instrument, not an orchestrator/conductor. Add a first-class user-editable elements/primitives domain for render/custom elements with schema/registry/discovery/CLI/install/sync/fork/inspect/list/update behavior where appropriate. Bundle default elements in this repo initially and install/sync them by default; design the model so external git/package/catalog defaults can be supported later without storing executable code in a DB. Make defaults fork-on-edit into workspace/theme overrides. Scan multiple roots with priority active theme > user workspace overrides > installed packages > bundled/default managed elements. Add dependency installation/update support for newly created/used custom elements, including JS package deps and Python requirements where declared, without silently mutating global environments. Do not enforce internal structure inside external executors: VibeComfy and future executors may have their own internal workflows/nodes/prompts; ArtAgents should require only a manifest/API boundary for exposing elements/metadata. Keep existing performer/executor install behavior intact where backcompat requires it.   "patch": "*** Begin Patch\n*** Add File: README.md\n+# ArtAgents\n+\n+![ArtAgents architecture: orchestrators route work to executors and render elements](docs/assets/artagents-orchestration.png)\n+\n+ArtAgents is a file-based toolkit for producing Reigh-compatible video edits,\n+event-talk renders, generative timelines, and image/video assets.\n+\n+The public model has three canonical concepts:\n+\n+- **Orchestrators** coordinate workflows. `conductors` is the legacy alias.\n+- **Executors** run concrete work. `performers` and `instruments` are legacy aliases.\n+- **Elements** are render/custom primitives such as effects, animations, and transitions. `primitives` is the legacy alias.\n+\n+Use canonical commands for new work. The alias commands remain available for\n+older scripts and docs.\n+\n+## Agent Prompt\n+\n+Copy this into a coding agent:\n+\n+```text\n+Use the ArtAgents repo:\n+https://github.com/banodoco/ArtAgents\n+\n+First read AGENTS.md, README.md, and SKILL.md, then run:\n+git status --short\n+python3 pipeline.py doctor\n+\n+Use canonical terms and commands: orchestrators, executors, and elements.\n+Legacy aliases remain supported: conductors, performers, instruments, and primitives.\n+\n+Keep generated files under runs/ unless the task explicitly touches generated\n+Remotion registries. Do not commit secrets or media. Before editing, check for\n+dirty user files and do not overwrite unrelated changes.\n+```\n+\n+## First Commands\n+\n+Run these from the repository root before making changes:\n+\n+```bash\n+git status --short\n+python3 pipeline.py doctor\n+python3 pipeline.py orchestrators list\n+python3 pipeline.py executors list\n+python3 pipeline.py elements list\n+python3 pipeline.py setup\n+```\n+\n+`setup` is dry-run by default. It reports the managed default element sync and\n+local dependency-install plan without mutating the workspace. Use\n+`python3 pipeline.py setup --apply` only when you intend to materialize defaults\n+and run local element install helpers.\n+\n+## Quick Start\n+\n+```bash\n+# Source-video hype cut\n+python3 pipeline.py --video source.mp4 --brief brief.txt --out runs/example --render\n+\n+# Audio-backed timeline\n+python3 pipeline.py --audio rant.wav --brief brief.txt --out runs/audio --render\n+\n+# Pure-generative timeline\n+python3 pipeline.py --brief brief.txt --theme 2rp --out runs/generative --render --target-duration 28\n+\n+# Event-talk render\n+python3 bin/event_talks.py render --manifest runs/event/talks.json --out-dir runs/event/rendered\n+```\n+\n+Generated outputs belong under `runs/`. That directory is ignored by git and can\n+contain frames, JSON files, audits, and rendered videos from local experiments.\n+\n+## Discovery\n+\n+```bash\n+# Canonical\n+python3 pipeline.py orchestrators list\n+python3 pipeline.py orchestrators inspect builtin.hype --json\n+python3 pipeline.py executors list\n+python3 pipeline.py executors inspect builtin.render --json\n+python3 pipeline.py elements list\n+python3 pipeline.py elements inspect effects text-card --json\n+\n+# Compatibility aliases\n+python3 pipeline.py conductors list\n+python3 pipeline.py performers list\n+python3 pipeline.py instruments list\n+python3 pipeline.py primitives list\n+```\n+\n+Default orchestrators include `builtin.hype`, `builtin.event_talks`, and\n+`builtin.thumbnail_maker`. Default executors include the built-in pipeline\n+stages such as `builtin.transcribe`, `builtin.cut`, `builtin.render`, and\n+`builtin.validate`, plus external executors such as `external.moirae` and\n+`external.vibecomfy.run`. VibeComfy is an executor/performer/instrument only,\n+not an orchestrator/conductor.\n+\n+Default elements are bundled in this repository and can be synced into\n+`.artagents/elements/managed`. User-editable forks and overrides live under\n+`.artagents/elements/overrides`:\n+\n+```bash\n+python3 pipeline.py elements sync --dry-run\n+python3 pipeline.py elements fork effects text-card\n+python3 pipeline.py elements install effects text-card\n+python3 pipeline.py elements update --dry-run\n+```\n+\n+Element source priority is active theme, then `.artagents/elements/overrides`,\n+then `.artagents/elements/managed`, then bundled defaults in\n+`artagents/elements/bundled`.\n+\n+## Main Commands\n+\n+```bash\n+# Rerun a pipeline from a specific stage\n+python3 pipeline.py --video source.mp4 --brief brief.txt --out runs/example --from cut --render\n+\n+# Audit a run\n+python3 pipeline.py audit --run runs/example\n+python3 pipeline.py audit --run runs/example --json\n+\n+# Fetch canonical Reigh data through the app Edge Function\n+python3 pipeline.py reigh-data --project-id <PROJECT_UUID> --shot-id <SHOT_UUID> --out runs/reigh/shot.json\n+\n+# Render a Reigh-compatible timeline/assets pair\n+python3 bin/render_remotion.py \\\n+  --timeline runs/example/briefs/my-brief/hype.timeline.json \\\n+  --assets runs/example/briefs/my-brief/hype.assets.json \\\n+  --out runs/example/briefs/my-brief/render.mp4\n+```\n+\n+## Repo Map\n+\n+```text\n+artagents/                 Python implementation\n+artagents/orchestrators/   Canonical orchestration package\n+artagents/conductors/      Orchestrator compatibility package\n+artagents/executors/       Canonical executor package\n+artagents/performers/      Executor compatibility package and curated external executors\n+artagents/elements/        Element schema, registry, CLI, and bundled defaults\n+.artagents/elements/       Local managed defaults and user overrides\n+bin/                       Direct stage launchers\n+remotion/                  Remotion renderer project\n+scripts/                   Development and code-generation scripts\n+examples/                  Small schema fixtures\n+_reference/                Copied Reigh contract references\n+runs/                      Ignored local outputs\n+```\n+\n+`pipeline.py` is the primary entry point. `bin/*.py` launchers call the matching\n+modules under `artagents/` when you need a single stage directly.\n+\n+## Outputs\n+\n+The main pipeline writes source-level artifacts into the run directory and\n+brief-level artifacts under `briefs/<slug>/`:\n+\n+```text\n+runs/example/\n+  transcript.json\n+  scenes.json\n+  shots.json\n+  pool.json\n+  audit/\n+  briefs/\n+    my-brief/\n+      arrangement.json\n+      hype.timeline.json\n+      hype.assets.json\n+      hype.metadata.json\n+      hype.mp4\n+      validation.json\n+```\n+\n+## Generated Files\n+\n+Normal generated media, frames, intermediate JSON, and local reports belong\n+under `runs/` or another ignored output directory. Do not commit secrets, large\n+source media, rendered videos, or local dependency environments.\n+\n+Generated Remotion registry files are source artifacts when element code\n+changes. Keep generated siblings synchronized across `.ts`, `.js`, `.d.ts`, and\n+`.map` outputs in `remotion/src`, and scan for stale primitive aliases after\n+regeneration:\n+\n+```bash\n+python3 scripts/gen_effect_registry.py\n+rg \"@workspace-|primitive-root|workspace-effects|workspace-animations|workspace-transitions\" remotion/src scripts remotion -n\n+```\n+\n+## Development\n+\n+```bash\n+python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt\n+pytest\n+\n+cd remotion\n+npm run typecheck\n+npm run smoke\n+npm run gen-types\n+```\n+\n+Run `npm run gen-types` after effect, animation, transition, or theme primitive\n+changes. Local secrets belong in `.env`, `.env.*`, or `this.env`; these are\n+ignored by git.\n+\n+## Dirty-File Caution\n+\n+Always inspect `git status --short` before editing. This repository often has\n+active generated artifacts and local skill edits. In particular, do not overwrite\n+unrelated changes in curated executor skill files such as\n+`artagents/performers/curated/moirae/SKILL.md` or\n+`artagents/performers/curated/vibecomfy/SKILL.md`.\n+\n+## License\n+\n+Open Source Native License (OSNL) v0.2. See `LICENSE` for the full terms.\n*** End Patch\n"
}
